# ⚔️Duel Mode Update⚔️
The new game mode, "Duel Mode," is officially live!

Engage in an intense 1v1 showdown! Keep winning to rack up a streak and claim exclusive rewards!

In addition to the base stage, the new Japanese-style room stage "Imperial Court" has been added, where tranquility and razor-sharp tension coexist!

Prepare for serious battles that set themselves apart from the usual chaotic game modes!
# 🥷New Shinobi Bundles and gold items have arrived🥷
Featuring three unique Ninja skins, cursed katanas, and plenty of Ninjutsu emotes!
[media]

# 🎲Test Your Luck, Risk It All 🎲
Devil’s Roulette is a thrilling VR party game for 1-4 players, where you'll bravely pull the trigger of a pistol loaded with random live rounds.
[media]

# 🃏 Change Your Fate with Powerful Gadgets🃏
Turn the tables with unique gadgets!

How you use them is up to you!
[media]

# 🎁 Freely Customize Skins and Trinkets🎁
Customize everything from luxurious skins to various guns and trinkets!
[media]

# 🧱A Multitude of Madness-Filled Stages🧱
Play across numerous stunning stages!

Some feature unique gimmicks, and there are even stages exclusive to limited game modes!
[media]

# 💬 Join the Discord!!
Check our Discord for the latest news, player interactions, free skin giveaways, and more!

https://mydearest.net/DevilsRoulette-BazookaDiscord
[media]
